info.description:
AI Assistance Disclosure:
Tool: Codex (model: GPT-6), date: 2026-10-13
Scope: Combine existing User/Supplier request formats for gateway testing, add safe smoke checks, and adapt missing-token assertions to stock Envoy; remove the duplicate User Service health request.
Author review: Pending human review.

FoC Gateway (official Envoy v1.38.6). Import this file into Postman. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3003; never change it to 3001/3002 when testing the gateway.

Start with Gateway smoke checks: no credentials and no state changes. User and Supplier folders reuse the service collections' workflows and change account/location data. Do not run the whole collection against important accounts: Profile changes email/password and deactivates its generated account; Admin resets the bootstrap admin password, reactivates an account and changes roles; Supplier Write creates/updates/deactivates/restores a location.

Existing USER: set signupEmail and password, then send User Service / Session / Login (locate Login in the imported folder). It saves accessToken and refreshToken. Existing ADMIN: set adminEmail and adminPassword, then send Admin: login only; it saves adminAccessToken. Supplier requests use those same variables automatically. Token values start empty; do not export/share live token or password values.

For full User workflows, Mailpit must be reachable at mailpitUrl (default http://localhost:8025). Registration/Profile scripts generate account addresses and retrieve OTPs there. Full Admin workflow also needs adminEmail matching USER_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL and a bootstrapped admin. Run User before Supplier; expired tokens require login/refresh again. Stock gateway 401 errors are text, while forwarded service validation errors remain service JSON. See api-gateway/envoy/behaviour-differences.md.

Source request examples: user-service/postman/user-service.postman_collection.json and supplier-service/postman/supplier.postman_collection.json. Earlier service-specific disclosures remain attributable in those source files.

Validation runs in a pipe, before the service, so a 400 never touches the rate limiter - which is why the fixed addresses in this folder are safe to reuse every run.

At least 8 characters with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit. The ceiling is 72 bytes, because that is all bcrypt reads - two passwords sharing a 72-byte prefix would otherwise verify against the same hash.
